name: voino
description: Get all your meetings notes the second they end, like excalidraw.

paragraphs: Listen. Understand. Edit. Voino turns what is said in meetings, lectures and discussions into editable notes and a hand-drawn, Excalidraw-style board you can rearrange and share.
Built with Flutter for Android and the web. Local-first: notes work with no account, no server and no API key. AI summaries are optional.

Status: prototype. Latest completed review baseline passed 60 Flutter tests and 12 Node tests; CI built a release web preview and Android debug Test Store APK. New mobile board/settings fixes are under review tests. Physical Android speech, storage and purchase acceptance are still pending. Main/site may lag the review branch. Production signing and live billing are not complete. See Known limitations.

requirements.text: Local-first: notes work with no account, no server and no API key.
The Vaani API key lives only in server environment variables (VAANIAPIKEY, optional VAANIAGENTID) on api/vaani-dispatch.js; it never reaches the client.
No accounts, sync or offline app install.
